source_of_truth: Mac Ableton Live; one current DAW writer; public score is not an ALS
clock_policy: No assumed global BPM. Ableton owns musical time; each source clip keeps original duration. The console clock is wall-independent rehearsal elapsed time, not Show Score musical transport.

status_legend.EXISTS_UNAPPROVED: Real local source/derived audio exists but artist listening decision pending
status_legend.PLAN_ONLY: Cue/placement proposal; no claim of a finished track
status_legend.CONDITIONAL: Use only after listening, sourcing and approval

available_sources.name: 回返 · piano + response
available_sources.detail: 38-note programmed piano; four whole-phrase extracts (0–25.5, 25.5–49.5, 61–89, 97.3–120 s), dry piano/electronic response, Hold/Release and scripted NEXT variants

available_sources.name: 重量 · sub/body/texture
available_sources.detail: Sub Stack-derived low event and long hold, four stems; original Live engine resampling verified, M0 independent ALS reopen pending
available_sources.private_package: awakening-m0-weight-v001 (actual local package name/version must be checked)

sections.title: 低频 / 进入
sections.musical_action: Sparse sub events separated by sufficient silence; choose a held source only if audition passes
sections.visual_action: Existing stone/light field with large static negative space
sections.performer_decision: Permit, delay or omit a second impact
sections.exit_rule: Manual NEXT after tail, not on a 5-minute alarm

sections.title: 钢琴 / 近景
sections.musical_action: Protect complete human-legible piano phrases; start bare then allow one electronic reply
sections.visual_action: Nearly still: piano remains foreground, avoid gesture-driven flashes
sections.performer_decision: Queue next phrase, then wait for phrase-end release
sections.exit_rule: Deferred NEXT only; direct APC clip launch disabled until tested

sections.title: 残响 / 漂移
sections.musical_action: Reuse selected material's electronic tail, no weak M2 invented solely to fill five minutes
sections.visual_action: Quest spatial scan/trace can shape light field without changing audio
sections.performer_decision: HOLD / RELEASE bounded tail; duration judged by ear
sections.exit_rule: Manual release and let tail clear

sections.title: 压力 / 接近
sections.musical_action: Sub body grows by articulation/spacing rather than master gain; prepare the sole major impact
sections.visual_action: Reduce distance/light contrast, not continuous heavy animation
sections.performer_decision: Choose timing of next low event; maintain headroom

sections.title: 主峰 / 撤除
sections.musical_action: Single earned eruption, then stop supporting layers; leave room for true silence
sections.visual_action: Existing stone/light contrast reaches one clear strong state then withdraws
sections.performer_decision: One impact and an explicit RELEASE; no forced repeated rise

sections.title: 回返 / 离场
sections.musical_action: Return one complete piano phrase or accepted counterpart; last 120s can absorb actual tail/safe exit
sections.visual_action: Clear HUD, return to near-stillness, then stage blackout (not music kill)
sections.performer_decision: Give or withhold final line, then listen to decay
sections.exit_rule: Finish by ear; stage window has 2-minute exit/recovery allowance

safety.on_xr_stale: neutralize XR-dependent visual controls only; retain Ableton audio transport and acoustic hold policy, do not invent a new musical cue
